name: Sela
verdict: An events company owned by Saudi Arabia’s Public Investment Fund.
note: Tier illustrative; was Newcastle front sponsor until 2025/26.

why.text: Sela belongs to Saudi Arabia’s state fund, PIF. Saudi Arabia carried out a record 345 executions in 2024, and US intelligence assessed that the crown prince approved the operation that killed journalist Jamal Khashoggi. A famous shirt makes the country look good to millions of fans while that goes on. That’s called sportswashing.
why.messageLine: Saudi Arabia carried out a record 345 executions in 2024.
